title: Iran Military Warns US Forces Must Leave West Asia, Vows No Retreat
detail: Iran's military issued a stark warning that American forces must leave West Asia, declaring Iran 'will not retreat one step' amid ongoing US-Iran tensions. The statement signals continued Iranian resolve as diplomatic and military pressures mount across the region.

title: Five Men Arrested Near US Air Base on Suspicion of Terrorism Plot
detail: Five men were arrested near a US air base involved in the Iran war on suspicion of planning a terrorist attack, according to PBS. The arrests highlight heightened security concerns around US military installations in the region as the conflict continues.
